The '''alien construct''' was a unique [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located within the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]].

==History==
Constructed several thousand years before the rise of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], it was used by an unidentified alien species as a staging point for their colonization programs. Large and bulbous, the construct was dotted with docking domes across its exterior. Each docking dome would open to admit a ship, and be guided in by docking tendrils. By [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the station was abandoned, and there was no trace of the alien species that constructed it.

Despite being thousands of years old, the technology of the station was well above [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] levels of science. The station had once been self-sufficient, generating its own water and food, and there were no signs of weapons, indicating that it was a civilian outpost. The construct was also the resting place of the [[Codex]], a powerful [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-imbued artifact.

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], a shuttle from [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]]'s forces and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' were captured by the construct's docking tendrils which had malfunctioned over the years. Both crews sought a way to escape, and eventually [[Skirmish on the Alien Construct|encountered]] each other. Both crews were able to escape, however.

The station was considered to be a holy site by the [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]], and their own beliefs forbade them to set foot on the construct. However, their desire to retrieve the Codex forced them to brainwash the navigator, [[Makezh]] into doing their bidding. When the Codex was removed from the construct in 8 ABY by the crew of the ''FarStar'', Makezh eventually stole it from them and gave it to the Aing-Tii on [[Demonsgate]].
